auto_computed_from_real_data: links.gap_ref/dependency_ref (via real trace lookup by goal_id)
caller_supplied_and_validated: links.capability_refs -- the caller (who is reading/writing the specific overlay entry) supplies which capability/capabilities the evidence concerns; auto-deriving "every capability the goal requires" was tried and rejected (see auto_linking_rule) -- captureExperience() still validates each ref against the goal's real required_capability_refs AND the real overlay, rejecting any that don't resolve.
still_author_supplied_v1: evidence.source/detail (the raw real evidence text itself)
field_automation_split.rationale: Narrative/causal-judgment fields require human or agent reasoning about WHY something happened and what it means -- V1 automates only what is deterministically derivable from real structured data (status transitions, real Goal/Gap/Capability references). A future phase could add narrative generation; this phase does not.

classification_rule_table.result: REJECTED -- no Experience is ever created without real evidence

auto_linking_rule: links.gap_ref/dependency_ref are looked up from the REAL trace file by goal_id at capture time (never manually supplied) -- absent if the goal has no chain (e.g. a satisfied goal, consistent with PHASE-966 EC-03). links.capability_refs is caller-supplied and validated (see caller_supplied_and_validated above) -- NOT derived by scanning every capability the goal requires: PHASE-E2's own dry-run first tried that and found it over-broadly linked all 10 of goal_semantic_quality's required capabilities to an event that was really only ever about 1, so the design was corrected before this document was finalized.
corrects_experience_id_auto_validation: If corrects_experience_id is supplied, captureExperience() checks it resolves to a real, already-captured experience in the same run's prior-experience set -- fabricated or dangling references are rejected as validation violations, not silently accepted.
